title: Thermae · selected recorded remains
figure: Avramova 2024, Fig. 24 (digital p. 280 / printed p. 276), based on Nikolov 1968: 44, fig. 1
scope: Only the solid black masonry and catchment column footprints in Fig. 24, plus the pool floors. Source numbers are retained. Hatched peripheral fabric, dashed channels, arches, and small loose details are excluded.
limitation: A source-proportional plan relief. Raised shapes and colour are display conventions, not ancient wall height, surviving height, depth, water level, or a shared floor level. Catchment 6 was underground. No roofs, arches, missing walls, or phase chronology are reconstructed. Black ink has no explicit phase key in this figure. Raster boundary uncertainty is approximately ±3 pixels; very small irregularities are simplified.

features.label: Masonry recorded in solid black
features.note: Outer and inner edges, openings, detached semicircular feature 8, and breaks in the central wall are retained from the black-ink plan. No phase attribution is inferred.

features.label: Catchment 6 · column footprints
features.note: Avramova digital p. 62 / printed p. 58 identifies 6 as an underground catchment with brick columns supporting multiple arches. Only the square column footprints are traced; the arches and vertical relationship to the baths are not reconstructed.

features.note: Footprint traced inside the drawn steps; flat coloured surface identifies the basin and does not represent a reconstructed water level or depth.
